title: 通过条件锚定蒸馏稳定语言模型的持续学习
summary: 提出条件锚定生成蒸馏（CAGD），通过保留少量旧提示并用冻结的旧模型重建生成状态，在持续学习中保护模型行为。在219M掩码扩散模型上，四任务最终损失从2.927降至1.114，软目标优于硬回放。
summary_en: Introduces condition-anchored generative distillation (CAGD), which retains a small set of old prompts and uses a frozen previous model to reconstruct generation states, protecting learned behavior during continual learning. On a 219M masked diffusion model, four-task final loss drops from 2.927 to 1.114, with soft targets outperforming hard replay.
